question.text: What is the maximum period for which a mutual fund scheme (other than initial ELSS offering) can remain open for subscription?

explanation.text: The Logic: No scheme other than the initial offering period of equity linked savings schemes shall be open for subscription for more than 15 days. The Trap: 21 working days is the SEBI review period for offer documents, not the subscription period. Note: Same page contrasts two distinct periods: 15 days (NFO subscription) vs 21 working days (SEBI offer-document review).
